description: One public documentation page as Markdown, exactly as published, with its title, canonical URL, section and the date it last changed. It takes a path or URL on the documentation site, such as "/mcp/public/" or "https://docs.atlanticagenticlabs.com/mcp/public/". Only pages of the public documentation site are served: any other address, and any page not in the published index, is refused. A very long page is truncated, with a note and the URL of the full page.
